case: disk exhaustion, torn and malformed logs, abandoned temps, partial media
targets: lib/recovery.mjs readJsonl / appendJsonl / repairJsonlTail / atomicWrite / sweepTemps / diskGuard

expect.appendJsonl then read: 3 events: the torn fragment stays isolated on its own line and the new event is not lost
expect.repairJsonlTail: keeps a .torn- copy and the 2 valid lines

temps.expect: sweepTemps lists the first three (dead pids), never keep.json, removes single files only, no recursion

disk.diskGuard(dir, bigger than free): ok false with a message that nothing was deleted
disk.ENOSPC during atomicWrite: temp removed, target unchanged, error classified permanent with owner_action 'free space'
